name: B10-0057/2026 – After § 9a – Am 10
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the murder of Mehdi Kessaci: urgent need for ambitious European action against drug trafficking
part_text: 9c. Notes that the main and most violent contemporary drug trafficking organisations in Europe, such as the DZ Mafia, the Mocro Mafia, Black Axe and Foxtrot, are largely made up of immigrants or descendants of immigrants, often from the Maghreb and Africa, where traffickers seek refuge to escape justice; calls for specific agreements between the EU and the countries of the Maghreb and Africa to facilitate the extradition and prosecution of traffickers as part of a zero-tolerance policy towards international drug trafficking;
